desc:
From innocence to maturity, from confusion to resolve.
The long path ahead stretches on, and she grips her sword and presses forward, walking a path untrodden.
Until her blade flashes like a soaring swan, illuminating the clouds above.

<color=#959595>"Whenever I swing my sword, it grows warm... It's comforting." —Ye Shunguang</color>
desc2: Equip to increase Attack Agents' combat capabilities
desc3: The world may change, but my heart remains constant, like clouds standing eternal.
name: Cloudcleave Radiance

1.desc: The equipper's DMG ignores <color=#2BAD00>20%</color> of the target's <color=#F0D12B>Physical RES</color>. When the equipper activates an <color=#FFFFFF>Ether Veil</color>, the equipper's DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> and CRIT DMG increases by <color=#2BAD00>25%</color> for 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
